result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverage types, limits, the data-processing trigger for cyber coverage, and certificates on request. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is unnecessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. Unrelated provisions are substantively preserved, but the drafting is structurally flawed because Section 14.11 appears before newly added Section 14.10 and the substantive insurance clause follows the complete-agreement/signature recital.
